name: mario trozzolo
description:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
AI consultant, strategic advisor, digital commerce specialist, and long-term private investor with a decade of consulting experience (2016–present). Creator of LE-1, a personal strategic intelligence framework integrating AI-supported reasoning, narrative analysis, and decision-support workflows. Since 2010, built and operated TGCShoes.com across GoDaddy, Google Shopping, Amazon Marketplace, and MSN Commerce. Lifetime member of WordPress and Divi Builder with hands-on experience designing and maintaining modern websites. Combined decades of real-world judgment with modern digital fluency, helping individuals and organizations adapt to the AI-driven economy with clarity and confidence.
CORE ADVISORY STRENGTHS
•	- AI-Supported Workflow Integration
•	- E-Commerce Strategy & Digital Retail
•	- WordPress & Divi Builder Website Development
•	- Customer Experience Optimization
•	- Retail & Service Operations
•	- Sales & Revenue Strategy
•	- Investment Strategy & Market Analysis
•	- Change Management & Leadership
•	- Communication & Stakeholder Alignment
AI CONSULTANT & DIGITAL STRATEGY ADVISOR
Independent Practice | 2016–Present
•	- Guide individuals and small businesses in integrating AI tools into daily workflows, customer service, and digital operations.
•	- Translated complex AI concepts into clear, actionable strategies for non-technical users.
•	- Supported organizations in digital transformation, including e-commerce expansion and workflow modernization.
•	- Provide strategic insight based on decades of cross-industry experience.
CREATOR & ARCHITECT — LE-1 STRATEGIC INTELLIGENCE FRAMEWORK

•	- Developing dashboards, logic engines, and workflow patterns to help individuals and small businesses navigate complexity.
FOUNDER & E-COMMERCE OPERATOR — TGCShoes.com
2010–Present
•	- Built and managed a multi-platform online footwear business across GoDaddy, Google Shopping, Amazon Marketplace, and MSN Commerce.
•	- Designed and maintained all online storefronts using WordPress and Divi Builder (lifetime member).
•	- Managed product catalogs, digital merchandising, SEO fundamentals, and analytics dashboards.
•	- Integrated plugins, payment systems, and automation tools to streamline operations.
PRIVATE INVESTOR & PORTFOLIO STRATEGY ADVISOR
1996–Present
•	- Manage a long-term investment portfolio with a focus on strategic asset allocation and market-cycle awareness.
•	- Analyze macroeconomic trends and sector-level shifts to inform decisions.
•	- Use AI-supported tools for market analysis and scenario modeling.
•	- Provide informal guidance on financial literacy and long-term planning.

•	- Millwork Customer Service Specialist — Home Depot | 2018–2021
•	- Customer Service Representative — HGS | 2018–2019
